title: [storage] While the archive's growth cannot be measured yet, the storage card says from when it will be
prompt:
Read crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/storage.rs (`growth`, `GROWTH_MIN_MS`, `sizes`: the archive's growth is measured from the oldest `host.storage` sample of the last 7 days), web/src/resources.ts (`normalizeStorage`, `storageView`, `StorageView`), web/src/format.ts (`localDateTime`) and web/src/components/fleet/HealthStrip.tsx (the Storage card).

The problem (owner via lead-mac, 2026-11-12 11:35 and 13:50; sync/roadmap-effects.md, "North-star and guardrail metrics", Storage). The storage north star is the archive's growth a day and how long the disk lasts at it (objective 065). Both need one sample at least a day old. So for the first day after the samples start (a fresh install, or live since 11-12 07:30), the card says "not measured yet" and "How long the disk lasts: not measured yet". The reader cannot tell a figure that is on its way from one that is broken; lead-mac asked about exactly this at 11:35. The samples already say when it comes: the oldest of the last 7 days, plus a day.

Required behaviour.
(a) `GET /api/fleet`'s `health.storage` carries `growth_from_ms`: the moment the growth is first measured, which is the at_ms of the oldest `host.storage` sample of the last 7 days (the one the growth is measured from) plus one day. It is null when there is no such sample, or no workspace root, as for the growth.
(b) web/src/resources.ts: `normalizeStorage` keeps `growth_from_ms`, and `storageView(storage)` carries `measured_from`. While `growth_bytes_per_day` is null and `growth_from_ms` is after the storage's `read_at_ms`, the "Transcript archive" row's note is "measured from <localDateTime(growth_from_ms)>" (the local date and time, e.g. "measured from 2026-11-13 07:31"), and `measured_from` is that date and time. Otherwise `measured_from` is null and the note is as today: "grows about <size> a day", or "not measured yet". A moment already past promises nothing. `lasts` is unchanged. The module keeps loading with node alone.
(c) The card's last line says "How long the disk lasts: measured from <measured_from>" when it is set, and is otherwise as today. Read off a screenshot.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/083.sh. The history is seeded as the store holds it: two `host.storage` samples, 10 h and 2 h before one fixed "now", over a 3 MiB archive. `spawn serve` answers. Checks:
- (1) through `GET /api/fleet`: health.storage has growth_bytes_per_day null and growth_from_ms equal to the 10 h sample's at_ms plus 86400000;
- (2) under node with TZ=Asia/Shanghai, storageView over that answer gives the note "measured from <its local date and time>", the same as measured_from, with lasts null. For a growth_from_ms of 2026-11-12 23:31:20 UTC an hour after read_at_ms it gives "measured from 2026-11-13 07:31". With a growth of 5 MiB a day it gives "grows about 5.0 MB a day" and measured_from null. With growth_from_ms null, or already before read_at_ms, it gives "not measured yet" and measured_from null.
It fails with 1 on 5a282615: there is no growth_from_ms, and storageView has no measured_from.

The product reason. The storage north star is new, and the first thing the owner sees of it is a blank. Saying when it will be measured turns "is something broken?" into a date. On live it reads "measured from 2026-11-13 07:30", and it disappears by itself once the growth is measured. Monitoring only: no gate, integrator or deploy step reads it.

Rules: never edit the protected paths, which the gate rejects: rsi/, scripts/ (scripts/rsi/, scripts/blackbox/, scripts/e2e.sh among them), deploy/, all of web/ except web/src/, web/test/ and web/index.html, rust-toolchain files and .cargo/. The gate also rejects fewer runnable tests than the base, any lint relaxation and any build-time code. The gate builds offline from the cargo caches already on the host. Keep every existing check green (065 and 074 read the storage figures) and add tests of your own for the new behaviour: a storage.rs unit test of growth_from_ms (a sample, none, no root), and web/test cases of storageView's measured_from (pending, measured, no sample, already past).
